audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was marked 'Skill' with a why claiming Warwick's passive wins extended auto wars, and the 2-item row was 'Skill' while whys[6] already said Warwick out-scales. The audited mirror has Level 1 to Urgot and 2+ items to Warwick.
audit.why: Corrosive Charge reaches 800 units and Echoing Flames fires off his basics, so Warwick has no level-1 auto war to win; his passive only heals below 50% health, which is exactly where Urgot's execute wants him.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side + win[0] set to Urgot (rating 4/10), phases[6].side + win[6] set to Warwick (rating 7/10), and phases[0].why rewritten to the real range problem.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text attributed Urgot's shield to his Q.
audit.why: The shield is on Disdain (E), not Corrosive Charge (Q). Q is the slow-and-poke charge; E is the charge that shields him and hurls a caught champion away. Purge also scales to 0 mana and a 0-second cooldown at rank 5, which is the real first-item spike and was never stated.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text rewritten to name Disdain as the shield and Purge's free-at-rank-5 scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the pages said what Disdain actually does to Warwick, and dosFull[1] was titled 'Dodge his E flip' with a description about Q-biting that had no connection to it.
audit.why: Disdain (E, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) charges, shields Urgot, and hurls a caught champion out of his way. Infinite Duress is a channelled suppression, so a displacement landing on Warwick cuts it short — the flip is both his escape and his answer to your ultimate. Purge (W) costs 40 mana on a 12s cooldown at rank 1 and drops to 0 mana with no cooldown at rank 5, so late in lane there is no window where it is 'down'.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d carries Disdain's 16s rank-1 cooldown and shield; dosFull[1].d states the flip cancelling your channelled R and to spend it before he does; dontsFull[0].d states Purge's rank-5 free uptime.

audit.why: 46.88% over 369 games; the page's 'EVEN' framing is the one thing I could not settle — see questionsForUser.

edits.before: Your passive sustain wins extended level-1 auto wars. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge reaches 800 units and his leg blasts fire off every basic, so there is no level-1 auto war for you to win here.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it, then R. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 and shields him. Fight only after it misses.

edits.before: Q-bite Urgot as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Disdain shields him and hurls you away, and it cuts your channelled R short — make him spend it first, or stand where it misses.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge is 12s at rank 1 but free with no cooldown at rank 5 — stop waiting it out.

edits.before: With Bami/tank items Urgot's Purge does even more sustained damage and his shield off Q keeps him healthy, so keep farming safely and wait for jungle pressure instead of soloing him.
edits.after: With tank items Purge hurts more and by rank 5 it is free — no mana, no cooldown — while Disdain (E) shields him, so farm safe and wait for jungle pressure instead of soloing him.

notes: spikes[2].text credited Urgot's shield to his Q; it is Disdain (E). Chart rows 0 and 6 were 'Skill' in both layers and contradicted their own whys — fixed as matched pairs to the mirror's answer. Purge's 0-mana/0-cooldown rank 5 was absent everywhere and is the single most useful fact in the matchup.
